name: app.threatnexus/threatnexus
title: ThreatNexus
description: Nation-state APT intel: actor dossiers, ATT&CK coverage, detection rules, intel search, IOC pivots

tools.name: search_actors
tools.description: Find nation-state threat actors in the ThreatNexus roster by name or alias, or list them by origin country, motivation, exploited CVE or ATT&CK technique. Returns short profiles with links; use get_actor for a full dossier. Lists are paged: when "next_offset" is a number, call again with that offset to get the rest ("count" is the full total). An alias shared by several actors returns status "ambiguous" with candidates.

query.description: Name or alias, e.g. "APT34", "OilRig". Optional when a filter is given.

country.description: Origin country as ThreatNexus records it, e.g. "Iran", "Russia", "North Korea".

cve.description: Only actors whose dossier lists this CVE, e.g. "CVE-2023-23397".

technique.description: Only actors whose dossier lists this ATT&CK technique; a base id (T1566) also matches its sub-techniques.

offset.description: Skip this many results — pass the previous page's next_offset.

tools.name: get_actor
tools.description: The curated ThreatNexus dossier for one threat actor: attribution (with tier, confidence and evidence), ATT&CK techniques, malware, exploited CVEs, campaigns, infrastructure patterns, relationships, GCC/UAE relevance and sources. Choose sections to keep the answer short. "analyst_updates" adds intelligence approved by ThreatNexus analysts since the dossier was written.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".

sections.description: Sections to include. Default: overview, attribution, ttps, malware, campaigns, sources.

tools.name: search_campaigns
tools.description: Campaigns attributed in ThreatNexus. With an actor: that actor's curated dossier campaigns plus campaign names from recent reporting about it. Without one: campaign names from recent reporting across approved actors, newest first. Filter by keyword or to active campaigns.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".

active_only.description: Only campaigns reported inside the active window (reporting) or with no end date (curated).

tools.name: get_attack_coverage
tools.description: Either an actor's MITRE ATT&CK techniques with how many harvested detection rules cover each, or, for one technique, which actors use it and which detection rules cover it. Give exactly one of actor or technique.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".

tools.name: search_intel
tools.description: Search threat intelligence reporting that ThreatNexus has collected and analysed (vendor research, CERT advisories, news, CVE alerts), ranked by ThreatNexus' hybrid keyword and semantic search. Returns headlines, links, a ThreatNexus summary, CVEs and mentioned actors. Titles and summaries are third-party derived and marked _untrusted.

query.description: Keywords, an actor or malware name, a CVE id or an indicator.

tools.name: get_cve
tools.description: For one CVE: the ThreatNexus actors whose dossiers record exploiting it (use get_actor with the "cves" section for the dossier's note and CVSS), plus recent reporting that names this CVE. Reporting that mentions a CVE does not by itself mean an actor exploited it.

tools.name: map_actor_to_detections
tools.description: Detection rules (Splunk ESCU, Elastic, Sigma, Hayabusa and ThreatNexus hunting queries) that cover an actor's documented ATT&CK techniques. Metadata, covered techniques, licence and permalink — not the rule bodies. Considers up to 20 of the actor's techniques; for per-technique counts use get_attack_coverage.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".

tools.name: search_detections
tools.description: Search the detection rules ThreatNexus harvests (Splunk ESCU, Elastic, Sigma, Hayabusa, ThreatNexus hunting queries) by keyword, ATT&CK technique or source. Production rules first. Returns metadata, licence and permalink — not the rule bodies. Give at least one of query, technique or source.

query.description: Keyword matched against rule names and descriptions, e.g. "lsass", "scheduled task".

technique.description: ATT&CK technique; a base id also matches its sub-techniques.

tools.name: identify_actors_in_text
tools.description: Paste a report excerpt, alert or article (up to 4000 characters) and get the ThreatNexus-tracked actors it names, using the same evidence-gated resolver ThreatNexus uses on its own ingest — designators such as "APT34" count on sight, weaker aliases only with naming context. Each match links to its dossier. A name in a text is a mention, not an attribution.

text.description: The text to scan. Sent to ThreatNexus for this lookup only; it is not stored or logged.

tools.name: explore_relationships
tools.description: The relationships ThreatNexus dossiers state for an actor (subgroup, overlaps, related-to, similar), one or two hops out, as nodes and edges with confidence. Also lists other actors whose dossiers share distinctive malware or CVEs with it — computed overlap, not a stated relationship.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".

tools.name: pivot_indicator
tools.description: Every report ThreatNexus has collected that published an indicator (IP, domain, URL, email, hash, …) — how many independent reports, with links — plus which tracked actors co-occur with it in verified reporting. Accepts defanged input. Returns no third-party reputation verdicts.

indicator.description: The indicator, plain or defanged, e.g. "evil[.]example[.]com" or a SHA-256.

tools.name: get_report_indicators
tools.description: The indicators ThreatNexus extracted from one collected report, with extraction confidence, defanged. Use a report_id from search_intel, get_cve or pivot_indicator.

report_id.description: The report_id field of a search_intel, get_cve or pivot_indicator result.

min_confidence.description: Only indicators scored at least this (1–100); unscored ones are then excluded.
